text: The Designated Manager must not approve an applicant for registration as a trade marks attorney unless the applicant has or is entitled to: (a) a level 5 or higher AQF qualification; or (b) a qualification awarded by an overseas institution that the Board is satisfied is equivalent to a level 5 or higher AQF qualification.
title: Academic qualifications

units.text: The Designated Manager must not approve an applicant for registration as a trade marks attorney unless the applicant has or is entitled to:
(a) a level 5 or higher AQF qualification; or
(b) a qualification awarded by an overseas institution that the Board is satisfied is equivalent to a level 5 or higher AQF qualification.
